name: Trilinga Kshetras — the Three Lingas of the Telugu Land
theme: Srisailam, Kaleshwaram and Draksharamam, the three Shiva shrines held to mark the bounds of Trilinga Desa, the Telugu country
description: A widely told tradition derives the name of the Telugu land, Trilinga Desa, from three great shrines of Shiva that mark its bounds: Srisailam in the Nallamala hills, Kaleshwaram at the meeting of the Godavari and the Pranahita, and Draksharamam in the Godavari delta near the coast. Each is a pilgrimage centre in its own right: Srisailam is a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha, Draksharamam is one of the Pancharama Kshetras and seat of the goddess Manikyamba, and Kaleshwaram is known for its two lingas on a single pedestal, of Shiva and of Yama. Visiting all three traces the old heartland of the Telugu language from the forests of the Krishna to the delta of the Godavari.
